messages:
tara m: Heads-up — Medora Labs wants a fast POC to validate two variants: redwood-chat-13b and their custom-quant-13b-clinical. Key asks: p95 <=220ms at ~512 tokens, BAA/KMS posture, and a committed monthly estimate for 60 req/s sustained.

nate p: From infra: Dedicated can hit those numbers but custom quant needs a compile pass. Ask them for tokenizer + manifest and sample prompt distribution.

sophia: Security: BAA + KMS + private control plane. Also confirm whether logs should go to their SIEM; if so we need trusted S3 endpoints/VPC peering.

tara m: They said PHI may appear in production. Sales wants a single-tenant option for the POC.

nate p: Single-tenant nodepool is fine, but costs increase. Quick sketch: 6x A10 GPUs reserved with autoscale buffer. I'll run a micro-benchmark.

sophia: I'll send the security checklist and BAA template. Also ask for SOC2 evidence and their security contact.

tara m: Pricing ask — rough committed monthly number for 60 rps, avg 512 tokens. Need something for exec summary.

nate p: Quick calc: 60 rps * 512 tokens = 30,720 t/s -> 2.65B tokens/day -> ~80B tokens/month. Hosted per-token would be expensive. Recommend mapping to GPU-hours: estimate 6x A10 reserved + buffer, then apply enterprise discount. I'll post a ballpark in the afternoon.

infra-bot: [job queued] compile-bench id=mb-79988 nodepool=dedicated-a10 eta~20m

sophia: If they insist on on-prem model drop, note it adds ~1-2 weeks and DTA/legal review. Prefer VPC S3.

tara m: Action items:
- sophia: BAA + security checklist to customer (ETA EOD)
- nate p: run bench + share p50/p95 and GPU util (ETA 6-8h)
- tara m: request model artifacts + 1k sample prompts + their tokenizer (ETA today)

nate p: Bench started. If custom quant compile fails, plan fallback to float16 or route traffic to redwood-chat-13b until kernels are fixed.

infra-bot: [update] mb-79988 status=running

sophia: Also confirm whether audit logs retention needs to be >1 year; that affects storage pricing.

tara m: Scheduling customer sync Wednesday 11:00 PT. Please join. Any blockers?

nate p: Only potential blocker is a kernel compile failure; will report back.

sophia: Need their security contact and PHI scope before the call.

tara m: Thanks — Ie28099ll post the S3 link when they upload.
